content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Charlotte

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's formal education and professional experience criteria to confirm you meet the baseline. Document your project roles and responsibilities—employers across Charlotte's finance, healthcare, technology, and manufacturing sectors recognize this credential.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our interactive sessions cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application. Attend from anywhere—no commute required. You'll earn all 35 PMI contact hours needed to qualify for exam eligibility upon course completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Exam Fee
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your formal application through PMI's portal, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the required exam fee. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your exam. Allow time for processing—plan ahead if your target exam date is approaching.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and live review sessions, to reinforce core concepts. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center. The PMP® exam is proctored and computer-delivered. Plan dedicated study time in the weeks leading up to your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, you must renew every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and learning opportunities to support your ongoing development. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates commitment to professional growth in your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
